policy_title: Bone Turnover Marker Testing for Osteoporosis Policy

sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to services reported using the 1500 Health Insurance Claim Form (a/k/a CMS-1500), UB04 claim form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form. This policy applies to all products, all network and non-network physicians and other qualified health care professionals, outpatient facility claims, Ambulatory Surgical Centers (ASC), Outpatient Surgical Centers (OSC), including, but not limited to, non-network authorized and percent of charge contract physicians, other qualified health care professionals or facilities.

children.title: United Healthcare Commercial
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all UnitedHealthcare Commercial benefit plans.

children.title: UnitedHealthcare Individual Exchange
children.content: This Reimbursement Policy applies to all Individual Exchange benefit plans.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for bone turnover marker testing associated with osteoporosis that are subject to frequency limitations.

sections.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive.
UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement of each of the following bone turnover marker testing procedure codes, Once every three Months, when billed for osteoporosis.

UnitedHealthcare will consider reimbursement for the bone turnover marker testing procedure codes listed above when billed with any other condition. Frequency limitation is only applicable when the codes are billed for the conditions listed above.

content.value: 90 consecutive calendar days from the initial date of service

value.Q: Is the Once every three Months limitation based on individual provider per member?
value.A: The Once every three Months limitation is applicable regardless of billing and/or rendering provider (any individual provider OR any facility) for each individual member for the same date of service.

value.Q: Does the frequency limitation apply per procedure code or do all procedure codes count toward the same limit?
value.A: The frequency limitation applies to each procedure code individually.

value.Q: Will UnitedHealthcare consider reimbursement of bone marker testing procedure codes when billed with other conditions?
value.A: Yes. The frequency limitation in this policy only applies when the bone marker testing procedure codes are billed for osteoporosis.
